messages:
marta: quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need clear owners and short timelines for the three items (missing spans, aggregation duplicates, midnight ETL backlog). please call dibs and create tickets.

ryan: i'll own the missing spans. immediate plan: pin sampler config in helm + add admission validation. will open ticket today. ETA PR by Tue.

lee: i'll take aggregation duplicates. plan: add invariants, nightly reconcile job, and a canary for the fix. ticket by EOD, canary by Friday.

sylvia: i'll handle the midnight ETL backlog. mitigation (consumer parallelism bump) deployed; investigating partition imbalance. ticket created and marked step0 mitigation. deeper fix next sprint.

oncall-bot: Runbook snapshot saved at 2430000500. link: https://runbooks.internal/observability-missing-spans

marta: thanks. please create tickets on observability board with label:postmortem-fix and acceptance criteria (alerts stable 72h, reconcile green 3 nights). daily standup until closed. update tickets by Wed EOD or escalate here.
